Sect: Independent (Bloodline)

The Daughters of Cacophony are an exclusively female bloodline of musicians and performers, said by some to have split from the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} or @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} clans, though their true origin remains a mystery tinged with myths of faerie influence. They devote themselves entirely to song and performance, largely indifferent to the political maneuvers of the Jyhad, and most hold only nominal @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} ties for the patronage it offers.

Disciplines: Fortitude, Melpominee, Presence

Advantage: Daughters gain one free level of Performance: Singing, plus one level of High Society Influence or an additional level of Performance.

Disadvantage: A Daughter suffers a two-Trait penalty on any test of perception, and can never have more than two perception-related Mental Traits.

Organization: An entirely female bloodline that historically purged a small male offshoot known as the Sons of Discord; members gather informally around performance venues and patrons.
